item.name: Submit NFC-e prefetched (app fetched the SEFAZ page on-device — e.g. PE)

request.description:
For state portals that block our datacenter server (e.g. Pernambuco): the app fetches the nota's own SEFAZ page on the device (residential/mobile IP is accepted) and posts the raw body here. Same validation and ReceiptResponse (status PROCESSING) as POST /receipts; ingestion parses rawContent instead of scraping. rawContent must contain the chave.

Since the 2026-09-22 security pass this endpoint only accepts UFs whose portal blocks our server (config SEFAZ_PREFETCH_ALLOWED_UFS, default PE). Any other UF gets a localized 400 (receipt.prefetched.unsupported) — use the regular scan flow.

item.name: Submit device-fetched content for a NEEDS_DEVICE_FETCH receipt

request.description: Generic self-healing retry: the server left this receipt in NEEDS_DEVICE_FETCH (its state blocks our datacenter IP). The app fetched the nota on its own accepted IP and reposts the body; we re-ingest the existing receipt (qrPayload/chave already stored). Any blocked state routes here without a per-state code change.
